reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 2 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Heat.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Heat win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.
